The classic card game application “Trima Solitaire” was born!
Friendly design for beginners to play!

Let's learn the Trima Solitaire terminology!
“Place Cards”.
A card is a stack of cards that are stacked vertically and arranged in seven horizontal rows.
The cards are arranged in rows of one, two, and three from the left, and only the front card is face up.
This is where the game is played.

The “pairs of cards.”
There are four spaces for diamonds, hearts, clovers and spades.
If you line up all the cards in order from A to 2, 3, 4, and so on, you have a solitaire clear!

The deck.
A deck is a pile of cards, like a stack of face-down cards.
When you can't go any further, you draw a card from here!
When you can't go any further, you can draw a card from here!


How to play
Sort the cards so that they are alternately red and black, with the smaller cards on the front side.
When you can no longer rearrange the cards on the front, turn over a card from the “deck”.
When an A card comes out, set it in the “deck” immediately.
While rearranging the cards in the deck, set the cards in the deck in order and turn over the deck.
Repeat this process until all cards are on the surface!

Help function
I'm stuck! I can't move it anymore! I can't clear the game. ～～～～
